Lead IT strategy and implementation: Lead the development and execution of IT initiatives across the property, ensuring alignment with area, cluster, and corporate technology objectives in collaboration with the Area Director of Technology Services.
li

Oversee system performance and security: Monitor and oversee the performance, security, and reliability of LAN, network servers, and IT infrastructure. Direct system upgrades, directory structures, and preventive maintenance to ensure optimal performance, security, and compliance.
li

Oversee technical support and issue resolution: Ensure timely identification and resolution of technical challenges relating to personal computing, software applications, and network connectivity. Establish effective support procedures and ensure appropriate training and guidance for Team Members to maintain a seamless technology experience.
li

Ensure compliance with IT standards: Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and upgrading of IT infrastructure, ensuring full compliance with Hilton Technology Network (HTN) standards and certification requirements, including the effective management of shared technology resources and backup procedures.
li

Direct technology projects: Lead and oversee major system implementations and technology projects, including workstation and server refreshes, Wi-Fi, PBX, and point-of-sale installations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within approved budgets, and with minimal operational disruption.
li

Ensure seamless hotel operations: Partner closely with property management and department heads to ensure the smooth operation of all hotel IT systems, maintain critical technology infrastructure, and proactively address technical issues to minimize downtime and business disruption.
li

Lead, inspire, and develop the IT team: Lead the recruitment, training, supervision, coaching, and development of IT team members. Conduct performance evaluations, establish development plans, delegate responsibilities, and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous professional growth.

d: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Manager, Markets Sales on the STP Derivative Sales team, you'll drive Coinbase Advanced's derivatives growth across the UAE, MENA, and Europe by originating and expanding relationships with professional traders. This team owns revenue and market share for Coinbase's derivatives products, including crypto perpetuals, options, and RWA products, across global markets. You'll personally own the client acquisition pipeline for the region, execute the regional sales strategy, and represent Coinbase as a senior market ambassador at events and conferences across some of crypto's fastest-growing markets.
q: li
8+ years in derivatives sales, trading, or structuring (crypto or FX/rates/equities) with direct P&L responsibility and a proven track record of independently sourcing and closing high-value clients.
li
Deep knowledge of the UAE, MENA, and European crypto regulatory and market environment, with demonstrated experience executing regional growth strategies in derivatives markets.
li
Demonstrable expertise in perpetual futures, futures, and options, with existing relationships across prosumer and advanced retail clients in the region.
li

Proven experience working with active and prosumer traders (e.g., high-value retail, professional day traders, social/desktop trading communities), ideally on derivatives platforms, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue or volume targets.
li
Willingness to travel regularly within the UAE, MENA, and Europe for client meetings, events, and conferences.
li
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
